name: Fushigi no Kabe
source:
In AD2069 girls of a famous school become attacked by monsters. According to gathered information, they become trapped in a mysterious wall. Main character challenges this wall to save the girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
公元2069年，一所著名学校的女孩遭到怪物袭击。根据收集到的信息，他们被困在一堵神秘的墙里。主角挑战这堵墙以拯救女孩们。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
